messages.text: So why does the site still offer reservations for the first 100 Harlo Loto miners? You guys already sold the first 100 reservations
Searched the catalog · Harlo Loto reservation

Good question, and the short answer is it isn't sold out. The Harlo Loto early bird deposit is still live in the store, and our stock on it shows 96 deposits left right now, so the reservations are still open.

Worth being straight about what the $20 buys: it's a deposit, not a miner. Nothing ships for it, the $20 comes off the unit price when Wave 1 opens, and it's fully refundable. Loto is still a prototype in development, built only if enough people reserve.

If you saw a "first 100 sold" line somewhere on the page, tell me where and I'll get Georges to check the wording.

You didn’t understand my question. The counter on the site for the first 100 was already sold out. You guys just started the counter over for an additional 100 but didn’t change the site to say it’s actually the second 100
Handed to the team · Cannot verify the counter's history or the page copy myself; wording on the Loto

Now I'm with you, and that's a fair point. I can only see what the store holds right now, which is 96 deposits left, so I can't tell you from here whether the counter rolled over from a first 100 or how the page is labelling it. I'm not going to guess at that.

I've passed it to Georges, who owns that page, so he can confirm which wave this is and fix the wording if it's wrong. Stay in the chat and he'll jump in here, and if you step away you'll get it by email.

Hi George. Can you make your site more clear that you are not currently on wave 1 and the first 100 spots for the Harlo miner is sold out. It’s deceiving. If you guys are making wave 1 larger with an additional 100 then just say that. They way it is now just seems like a scare tactic to entice people to buy it thinking there is only 100 at the $599 price. It’s also not far to the actual first 100 people that reserved.

That's Sarah still, not Georges, but your message is on his desk word for word, along with the point about fairness to the people who took the first 100 spots.

I'm not going to defend the counter when I can't see its history. What I can tell you honestly is what the store holds now, 96 deposits, and that the $20 is fully refundable either way.

He's on today and will come back to you here, or by email if you've stepped away.
